topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: There it was, tucked away in the corner, the soft, familiar fur a little worn but holding the same comforting weight. The button eyes, slightly askew, gazed back at me, and my hands moved on their own, cradling it just as I used to. The fabric, slightly faded, still held the essence of those early years, when the world was big and this bear was my fortress. It didn’t speak, but I could feel it, the silent cheer from deep within, a warmth that spread through me. The decision was easy, almost instinctive. This bear was coming home, where it belonged, with me.
